description: GRID3 NGA - Other POI: Energy and Electricity Substations is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by eHealth Africa. Energy and electricity substation locations and names in Nigeria. Released in September 2020. Dataset is incomplete for the country. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher eHealth Africa. Its tags are Nigeria, NGA, POI. The portal shows 2025-09-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
